# A click a control inside a clickable card handled is the control's: the
# card's @click does not hear it, on any target, as decided with the user.
#
# html's card heard the DOM bubble a button's click up to it -- a mouse's,
# and the one Enter on the button makes -- so pressing a card's button also
# opened the card. Fyne, GTK, Compose and the terminal hand a click to the
# innermost control already. codegen/platform/html/card_keys_browser_test.go
# presses the keys in a browser.
#
# Confirmed against the html card before: the button's click clicked the
# card as well.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '^ok +2 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '^ok +2 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout '^ok +2 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout '^ok +2 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout '^ok +2 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout '^ok +2 tests, 0 failures$'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component cardWithButton ui.node {
    var cardClicks = 0
    var buttonClicks = 0
    ui.card #card(clickable=true, @click { cardClicks += 1 }) {
        ui.text #label(value="a card")
        ui.button #inner(text="inner", @click { buttonClicks += 1 })
    }
}

func testTheButtonsClickIsTheButtons(t Test, c cardWithButton) {
    c.inner.click()
    t.assert(c.buttonClicks == 1)
    t.assert(c.cardClicks == 0)
}

func testTheCardsClickIsTheCards(t Test, c cardWithButton) {
    c.card.click()
    t.assert(c.cardClicks == 1)
    t.assert(c.buttonClicks == 0)
}

ui.window {
    cardWithButton
}
